# The Barn Fitness Collective

> Functional fitness gym in Sebastopol, CA: group classes, personal training, a recovery room (sauna and cold plunge), massage, and an official HYROX affiliate. All levels welcome.

Address: 6731 Sebastopol Ave, Suite 110, Sebastopol, CA 95472
Phone / text: (707) 242-1961
Email: zoe@thebarnfitnesscollective.com
Booking: via the Barn Fitness Co. app (iOS and Android) or the schedule page.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.thebarnfitnesscollective.com/): overview of classes, pricing, and coaches
- [Programming & Pricing](https://www.thebarnfitnesscollective.com/programming-and-pricing): classes, memberships, drop-in and class-pack pricing
- [Schedule & Book](https://www.thebarnfitnesscollective.com/schedule): class days, class times, and booking
- [HYROX Training](https://www.thebarnfitnesscollective.com/hyrox): official HYROX affiliate and the 12-week HYROX program
- [Recovery Room](https://www.thebarnfitnesscollective.com/recovery-room): sauna and cold plunge
- [Legends Program](https://www.thebarnfitnesscollective.com/legends-program): classes for members 55+
- [Wylde Bowls](https://www.thebarnfitnesscollective.com/eat): fresh Wylde Provisions Co. protein bowls sold at The Barn, Monday through Saturday
- [Our Team](https://www.thebarnfitnesscollective.com/our-team): the coaches
- [FAQ](https://www.thebarnfitnesscollective.com/faq): common questions about classes, pricing, parking, and more
- [Contact](https://www.thebarnfitnesscollective.com/contact): phone, email, directions, and class times

## Quick facts
- Drop-in class: $25. 10-class pack: $199. Memberships: $149/month (2 classes a week) or $199/month (unlimited).
- Classes run in windows through the week (see the Schedule page); open-gym hours are not guaranteed.
